description: Look up a recipient in the Migrant Program Money Register by name substring as the award records name it, by the register's family name, or by its exact 12-character UEI, optionally limited to one program. Returns up to 5 published recipients, each with its UEI, states, reviewed class and the basis for it, and the IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File record where one matches (EIN, the name and state the IRS lists, and the IRS's own codes); money by program and fiscal year; its 10 largest awards with obligations by fiscal year and award-level outlays as recorded, each labelled; its termination records in the agency's exact words with their dates; the subaward rows its prime awards report, as counts only (the register gives no subawardee total); and the register's side-by-side columns for its family: program money, LDA lobbying reports, connected PACs, ICE and CBP contracts and super PAC gifts, with the caption. An empty column is a search result, not a fact about the organisation. Every amount is an obligation from the award records (the government's commitment to pay), net of de-obligations, by action date; net obligations, positive obligations and de-obligations are separate stages, each labelled with its fiscal year and the as-of date, award-level outlays (only where the record carries them) are the record's cumulative figure to the as-of date, and they are never added across stages. Governments are kept apart from organisations: every amount names its recipient class from the register's reviewed table, never a single NGO total. A recipient is called an IRS-listed exempt organisation only where the register's IRS EO BMF match stands (by the reviewed EIN, or by exact name and state where the register marks the match by rule), shown with that record; other organisations read organisation, IRS status not matched. The tools never call a recipient nonprofit or faith-based, and no recipient is classified by religion. Terminations appear only in the agency's exact words with their dates; where the record gives no words the answer says the record gives no reason, and an executive-order tag appears only as the record shows it. Lobbying reports (LDA), connected PACs (FEC), ICE and CBP contracts (the Pay-to-Play Register, where ICE detention sits) and super PAC gifts (the Super PAC Donors Register) are side columns: shown side by side, never added to program money and never put in date sequence with an award or a termination. Every answer carries the register's question note: these records show federal awards and the agencies' own termination records; they do not show how any recipient used the money or why an award was made or ended beyond what the record says. Every answer also carries the side-by-side caption, the as-of and retrieval dates, each file's date, the source page on morvs.ai and the licence. Institutions only: no beneficiary, staff member, executive or sole proprietor is named; withheld recipients and records appear only as counts and amounts. A name that matches only a withheld string answers exactly like a name that matches nothing.

name.description: Required case-insensitive recipient name substring as filed, a family name or an exact 12-character UEI; at most 80 characters; published recipients only.

program.description: Optional program key, for example orr_uc, state_rp or fema_ssp: only recipients with money in that program, with that program's figures.
